explanation: Induction on k, generalizing d. For k + 1, the hypothesis at b = k gives 2^k d = r + 2^(k+1) m with |r| < 2^k; if d were odd, r = 2^k (1 + 2t - 2m) would have |r| >= 2^k, so d = 2 d'. For b < k the hypothesis at b gives 2^(b+1) d' = r + 2^(k+1) m, so r = 2 r' is even with |r'| < 2^(k-1) and 2^b d' = r' + 2^k m; the induction hypothesis gives 2^k | d', hence 2^(k+1) | d.
